app.name: Volume and channel controls
app.summary: Quieter, mute and louder, or channel down and up, each running the Home Assistant action you choose.
app.tile_example: Quieter, mute and louder, or channel down and up, across a wide tile or down a tall one
app.key_down_hint: The action of this key, such as media_player.volume_down (volume) or webostv.button button=CHANNELDOWN (channel). Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_mute_hint: Volume style only; the channel style leaves it out. Such as remote.send_command command=MUTE, or media_player.volume_mute is_volume_muted=true. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_up_hint: The action of this key, such as media_player.volume_up (volume) or webostv.button button=CHANNELUP (channel). Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.style_hint: Volume shows quieter, mute and louder. Channel shows two chevron keys, channel down and up, and leaves the mute key out.
